references.text: The spies report on the Anakim who lived in Canaan, and the Israelites feared them because of their great size.
The Anakim are mentioned as one of the reasons the Israelites were afraid to enter the Promised Land.
Refers to the Anakim as a large and tall people who lived in the land before the Israelite conquest.
Describes the Anakim as a large and tall people against whom no one could stand.
Caleb requests the Hebron area where the Anakim lived, and he drives them out from there.
Caleb drives out the three Anakite chiefs from Hebron.
Confirms that Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak from Hebron.
Goliath from Gath was likely a descendant of the Anakim who remained in Gath, as mentioned in this verse.
Philistine warriors from Gath who fought against David and his men, possibly descendants of the Anakim.
